## Change

Describe the mathematical or presentation change and link related statements.

## Review

- [ ] Hypotheses, notation, proofs, and physical interpretations reviewed.
- [ ] Literature citations checked against original sources.
- [ ] Existing labels and page URLs preserved where possible.
- [ ] Definitions live in their owning articles; references open whole pages.
- [ ] Separate theorem pages contain full statements and identify whether proofs
      are supplied; articles link to them without transcluding statements.
- [ ] `Wiki checks` passes and the rendered preview has been inspected.

Build checks verify structure and interactions, not mathematical correctness.
